blocked.field_has_grades_field: Grades have been entered in “{{field}}”; undoing would delete them, so nothing was undone.

blocked.field_has_history_field: “{{field}}” has grade history (from saves that were later undone), so adding it cannot be undone. Delete the field instead if needed; it is hidden and its history is kept.

blocked.cannot_deactivate_self_user: Undoing this would deactivate your own account ({{user}}), so nothing was undone.
